confirmed_examples.source: It needs a coffin, not a knife.

identity: Heh, just trying to be funny, when I shouldn't be.  A bad joke.  Nothing funny about it.  I meant only this: it isn't the Enemy the one that raises the dead here.  But, they're maybe similar in some way.  Not family, not part of the Enemy, but maybe an equal to it.  So don't take the joke for more than a joke.  It's not its partner, its wife, or its friend, because I doubt these things have such things.  Maybe just an illusion - a trick in the head.  But that's just my thinking - it's all unknown.
